items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: prepare/aggregate exist, JSON out, wrap the tools; gates from catalog; upgrade notes in code; run state once; deltas with source; check exit 0.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: After plan review: stop with a named reason on parse-commits failure, missing version, failed upgrade drop, failed fallback append and failed decision numbering; malformed --fallback-entry refused.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: argv lists only, no shell; run-state shape checked on read; run id taken from the environment only for a dispatched run; --end-of-options before a tag.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Each moved behaviour has a failing-on-old test (gates from catalog, upgrade drop, state across processes, stale state, error stops); all 43 scenarios and 20 promise tests pass through the CLI driver.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: About 6 uv runs per prepare, acceptable for a release command; no loops over data.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: Seven modules, each under 115 lines, one responsibility; tests under 300 lines.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Producer/consumer: release.py JSON -> driver_cli (real subprocess round trip through 43 scenarios) and run-state file written by prepare, read by aggregate in a separate process (test); gate catalog -> resolver rows (real resolver run).
